requirements.title: Remove a book
requirements.text: The system shall allow a book to be removed from the catalog by ISBN. Removal shall be refused while any copy of that book is on loan (available copies differ from total copies).

claims.text: A book can be removed from the catalog by ISBN.
Removal is refused while any copy is on loan.

requirements.title: Look up a book
requirements.text: The system shall return the book for a given ISBN, and shall raise an error stating that no book exists when the ISBN is not in the catalog.

claims.text: The book for a given ISBN is returned.
An error stating that no book exists is raised for an unknown ISBN.

requirements.title: Search the catalog
requirements.text: The system shall return all books whose title or author contains a given keyword, ignoring letter case.

claims.text: Books whose title or author contains the keyword are returned.
The match ignores letter case.

requirements.title: List available books
requirements.text: The system shall list the books that have at least one available copy, sorted alphabetically by title.

requirements.title: Search by publication year

requirements.title: Track copy availability
requirements.text: When a copy is checked out, the system shall decrease the book's available copies by one, and shall refuse the checkout when no copies are available. When a copy is returned, the system shall increase the available copies by one, and shall refuse the return when all copies are already in stock.

claims.text: Checking out a copy decreases the available copies by one.
A checkout is refused when no copies are available.
Returning a copy increases the available copies by one.
A return is refused when all copies are already in stock.

requirements.title: Export a book record
requirements.text: The system shall provide a dictionary representation of a book containing its ISBN, title, author, year, total copies and available copies.

claims.text: The dictionary contains ISBN, title, author, year, total copies and available copies.

requirements.title: Create a member
requirements.text: The system shall create a member with a member ID, name, email address and membership type (default `standard`). The email address shall match the pattern `local-part@domain.tld`; otherwise the member shall be rejected. The membership type shall be one of the supported tiers (see FR-012); otherwise the member shall be rejected. A new member shall have no active loans and zero outstanding fines.

claims.text: A member whose email does not match local-part@domain.tld is rejected.
A member whose membership type is not a supported tier is rejected.
The membership type defaults to standard.
A new member has no active loans and zero outstanding fines.

requirements.title: Register members
requirements.text: The system shall register members with the lending service and shall reject a registration whose member ID is already registered.

claims.text: Members are registered with the lending service.
A registration whose member ID is already registered is rejected.

requirements.title: Borrowing limits
requirements.text:
The maximum number of simultaneous active loans shall depend on the membership type:

| Membership type | Borrowing limit |
|---|---|
| standard | 3 |
| premium | 7 |
| staff | 10 |

claims.text: The borrowing limit for standard members is 3.
The borrowing limit for premium members is 7.
The borrowing limit for staff members is 10.

requirements.title: Borrowing eligibility
requirements.text: A member shall be eligible to borrow only when they have no outstanding fines and their number of active loans is below their borrowing limit.

claims.text: A member with outstanding fines is not eligible to borrow.
A member is eligible only while their active loans are below their borrowing limit.

requirements.title: Record fines
requirements.text: The system shall add a fine amount to a member's outstanding fines, rounded to two decimals. Negative fine amounts shall be rejected.

claims.text: A fine is added to the member's outstanding fines, rounded to two decimals.
Negative fine amounts are rejected.

requirements.title: Pay fines
requirements.text: The system shall allow a member to pay part or all of their outstanding fines and shall return the remaining balance. The payment shall be rejected if it is zero or negative, or if it exceeds the outstanding balance.

claims.text: A payment reduces the outstanding fines and the remaining balance is returned.
A zero or negative payment is rejected.
A payment exceeding the outstanding balance is rejected.

requirements.title: Deactivate a member
requirements.text: The system shall allow a librarian to deactivate a member. A deactivated member shall not be eligible to borrow books.

claims.text: A librarian can deactivate a member.
A deactivated member cannot borrow books.

requirements.notes: Members have no active/inactive state; can_borrow checks only fines and the loan limit.

requirements.title: Payment history
requirements.text: When a member pays a fine, the system shall return the remaining balance and shall record the amount and date of each payment in the member's payment history.

claims.text: Paying a fine returns the remaining balance.
Each payment's amount and date is recorded in the member's payment history.

requirements.notes: pay_fine updates the balance only; no payment history exists anywhere.

requirements.title: Check out a book
requirements.text: The system shall check out a book (by ISBN) to a registered member (by member ID). The checkout shall be refused if the member is not eligible to borrow (FR-013). On success the system shall reduce the book's available copies, create a loan with a unique, sequentially assigned loan ID starting at 1, attach the loan to the member's active loans and record it in the lending service. The loan start date shall default to today's date if not supplied.

claims.text: The checkout is refused if the member is not eligible to borrow.
A successful checkout reduces the book's available copies.
Loan IDs are unique and assigned sequentially starting at 1.
The loan is attached to the member's active loans.
The loan is recorded in the lending service.
The loan start date defaults to today.

requirements.title: Loan period
requirements.text: The due date of a new loan shall be 14 days after its start date.

claims.text: The due date of a new loan is 14 days after its start date.

requirements.title: Return a book
requirements.text: The system shall record the return of a loan by loan ID, with the return date defaulting to today. The system shall refuse to return a loan that was already returned. On return the system shall mark the loan as returned, increase the book's available copies and remove the loan from the member's active loans.

The loan is removed from the member's active loans.

requirements.title: Renew a loan
requirements.text: The system shall allow a loan to be renewed, extending the due date by another 14-day loan period, and shall return the new due date. A loan shall be renewed at most 2 times. Renewal shall be refused if the loan has been returned or is currently overdue.

Renewal is refused if the loan is currently overdue.

requirements.title: Overdue detection
requirements.text: The system shall compute the number of days a loan is overdue, using the return date if the loan has been returned, otherwise a supplied check date, otherwise today. The value shall never be negative. The system shall list all loans that are not yet returned and are overdue as of a given date.

claims.text: Days overdue use the return date, else a supplied check date, else today.

requirements.title: Due-date reminders

requirements.notes: No code sends email or schedules reminders; due dates exist only on Loan.

requirements.title: Renewal eligibility
requirements.text: A loan shall be renewed only when it has been renewed fewer than 2 times and the borrowing member has no outstanding fines.

requirements.title: Fine calculation
requirements.text:
The fine for a loan shall be calculated as follows:
- If the loan is overdue by 2 days or fewer (grace period), the fine is 0.00.
- Otherwise the fine is the number of overdue days multiplied by 0.50 per day.
- The fine for a single loan shall not exceed 20.00.
- The result shall be rounded to two decimals.

claims.text: A loan overdue by 2 days or fewer has a fine of 0.00.
Otherwise the fine is the overdue days multiplied by 0.50.
The fine for a single loan does not exceed 20.00.
The fine is rounded to two decimals.

requirements.title: Charge fine on return
requirements.text: When a book is returned, the system shall calculate the fine for that loan and, if it is greater than zero, add it to the member's outstanding fines. The return operation shall report the fine charged.

claims.text: The fine for the loan is calculated when the book is returned.
A fine greater than zero is added to the member's outstanding fines.
The return operation reports the fine charged.

requirements.title: Portability
requirements.text: The system shall run on Python 3.8 or later and shall use only the Python standard library.

requirements.title: Storage
requirements.text: The system shall keep all data in memory and shall not require a database or files.

requirements.title: Error reporting
requirements.text: Every rejected operation shall raise an exception with a human-readable message describing the cause.
requirements.notes: Mostly met, but an unknown member ID (LendingService.checkout) or loan ID (LendingService.return_book) raises a bare KeyError whose message is only the ID.
